title: At the Ironbound Mission, the dialogue option 'ask for the pitch' reads as an information request but actually and irreversibly resolves the 'Mission's Order' quest on the spot, committing you to the Ironbound's side of a three-way dispute (the Ironbound +1, the Gray Church -1) with no separate confirmation step.
where: Fenmarch / The Ironbound Mission / talk to Warder Iss
